title: mixcore core API v0.1: shared definitions

version.description: Contract version. v0 is unstable until the first tagged release.

kind.description: muteGroup and dca are v0.1 (x32: mute groups 1..6, DCA groups 1..8). Their only field is mute.

index.description: Required for input, muteGroup and dca (1-based). Omitted for main.

field.description: v0.1: muteGroups and dcas are the strip's group membership (read-only); effectiveMute is derived by the core and appears only in state messages, never in commands. For a muteGroup strip, mute true means the group is engaged (muting its members); for a dca strip, mute true means the DCA is muted.

level.description: A level in dB. JSON has no infinity, so fully off is the string "-inf". NaN never appears.

value.description: fader: level; mute: boolean (true = muted, or for a muteGroup: engaged); name: string; muteGroups/dcas (v0.1): groupList; effectiveMute (v0.1): effectiveMute object. The field decides the type.

groupList.description: v0.1: group numbers in ascending order, e.g. [2, 5].

effectiveMute.description: v0.1 (design CR-01, SR-04): whether the strip is silenced toward Main LR, and why. muted = own OR any listed group. muteGroups lists the engaged mute groups the strip belongs to; dcas lists the muted DCAs it belongs to (x32: a muted DCA silences its members toward Main LR only, unless the console preference says otherwise; per-bus effective mute comes with buses). UI text: 'MUTED by MG 2', 'DCA 1 muted'.
